title: Shopify–NetSuite Sync for Beverage Brands: Align Bottles, Cases, and Variety Packs
summary: How a Shopify to NetSuite two-way sync keeps bottles, single-flavor cases, and variety packs distinct so two purchased packs resolve to the right bottles.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Beverage two-way sync needs an approved relationship between the purchased Shopify pack and the ERP item or components. Keep bottles, single-flavor cases, and mixed variety packs distinct. Preserve the original variant and pack revision so fulfillment, returns, and finance can explain the same purchase without converting units by product-name guesswork.


Explore the complete[beverages integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/beverages) for the systems and processes around this guide.
